prompt: Create a dramatic vertical anime-style illustration of exactly two young adults on an outdoor stair landing, viewed from a very low, tilted upward angle with strong cinematic perspective. In the foreground, show a tall slim blonde young woman with long messy wavy hair and pale skin standing on the lower steps, turned slightly away but looking back over her shoulder with a cool, distant expression; she wears an oversized loose white long-sleeve shirt, wide black trousers, and holds a dark jacket draped in one hand. In the background on the upper landing, show a tall slim black-haired young man with messy hair and glasses standing near an open rooftop doorway, looking down toward the viewer with one hand in his pocket; he wears a dark button-up shirt with rolled sleeves and fitted black trousers. The setting contains exactly one open door on the upper right with a vivid red interior edge, one small shoe shelf beside it holding several pairs of shoes and one small red can on top, one metal railing, one large dark wall or curtain-like panel on the left, and a staircase with broad steps receding diagonally upward. Use a high-contrast stylized color palette of electric cyan blue shadows and saturated crimson red rim light, with sharp cel-shaded highlights across the clothing and stairs, glowing sky-blue clouds in the background, and blown-out white sky areas. Emphasize long legs, elegant fashion poses, wind-tossed hair, melancholy tension, and a fashion editorial mood. Add subtle motion blur near the lower foreground steps and the woman's foot, crisp character faces, thin expressive linework, painterly anime rendering, dramatic red-blue split lighting, no photorealism, no extra characters, no readable text except a tiny faint artist-signature-like mark on the left wall.

promptZh: 创作一张戏剧性的竖构图动漫风格插画，画面中仅有两名年轻人站在室外楼梯平台上，采用极低角度的仰视视角，呈现强烈的电影感透视。前景中，展示 一位身材高挑苗条、留着凌乱长波浪卷发的金发年轻女性，皮肤白皙 站在下方的台阶上，身体微侧，回头看向后方，表情冷漠疏离；她身穿超大款宽松白色长袖衬衫，搭配黑色阔腿裤，单手拎着一件深色外套。背景上方平台上，展示 一位身材高挑苗条、留着凌乱黑发并戴着眼镜的年轻男性 站在敞开的天台门口附近，单手插兜，俯视着观众；他身穿深色长袖衬衫，袖口卷起，搭配修身黑色长裤。场景包含：右上角一扇敞开的门，门框内侧呈现鲜艳的红色；门旁有一个小型鞋架，上面放着几双鞋和一个红色小罐子；一个金属栏杆；左侧有一面巨大的深色墙壁或类似幕布的面板；以及一道向斜上方延伸的宽阔楼梯。采用高对比度的风格化配色方案，阴影部分为电光青蓝色，轮廓光为饱和的深红色，衣物和楼梯上带有锐利的赛璐珞风格高光，背景为发光的天蓝色云朵和过曝的白色天空。强调修长的双腿、优雅的时尚姿态、随风飘动的头发、忧郁的张力以及时尚杂志般的氛围。在下方前景台阶和女性脚部附近添加细微的动态模糊，角色面部刻画清晰，线条纤细且富有表现力，采用绘画感动漫渲染，戏剧性的红蓝分离光影，拒绝写实风格，画面中不得出现额外角色，除左侧墙上微弱的艺术家签名标记外，不得出现任何可读文字。
